name: ocr-bill-suite
description: Unified workspace coordinating the FastAPI backend, Next.js user frontend, and Next.js admin dashboard.

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend-user && npm install --prefix frontend-admin
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "BACKEND,USER-FE,ADMIN-FE" -c "bgBlue,bgGreen,bgMagenta" "npm run backend-dev" "npm run frontend-user-dev" "npm run frontend-admin-dev"
